sections.text:
-Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 4 times with physical water damage at success of 70 points.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Casts a 60-second counter heal on all allies that recovers 15,000 HP each time damage is received.
-Heals the HP of all allies by 10% of their max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Casts frenzy on your character for 60 seconds.
